stemMd: Every value in a data set with standard deviation 4 is multiplied by −2. What is the new standard deviation?
explanationMd: Standard deviation scales by the absolute value of the multiplier. Multiplying by −2 reverses order but doubles distances from the mean, so the new standard deviation is 8.

distractorRationale.c: This divides rather than multiplies by the scale magnitude.
distractorRationale.d: Scaling changes spread, unlike adding a constant.
distractorRationale.b: This uses the variance scaling factor directly on standard deviation.
